_note: The angler: a cartoony fisher with a bushy ginger beard, a big round nose, a bucket hat, a tan fishing vest over a shirt in the player's colour, khaki trousers and green rubber boots, holding a rod in the right mitten. No boxes: the limbs are tapered eight-sided tubes (wide at the shoulder and thigh, narrow at the wrist and ankle), the head a twelve-sided ball, the beard a wedge, the hat a short cone with a flared brim, the vest a twelve-sided tapered body with a slight belly. Elbows and knees bend without a gap: the faces between the upper and lower part of each limb join vertices of both parts. The origin is between the feet; the angler faces +z and stands 1.62 m to the top of the hat. drive: seated on the back bench, right hand back on the tiller, left hand on the knee, rod put away (scale 0). fish: standing, the right hand on the reel and the left on the butt, rod held out over the bow. idle: a slow sway. Anchors: line is the rod's tip, where the fishing line starts; wrist_l is on the left forearm's middle, on its axis, where the Fish-Boy straps on (the forearm runs down -y at rest, the back of the wrist faces +x, its radius is about 45 mm).
name: Angler
